objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-asa-reconnaissance-command-activity
objects.description:
This analytic detects potential reconnaissance activities on Cisco ASA devices by identifying execution of multiple information-gathering "show" commands within a short timeframe.
Adversaries who gain initial access to network infrastructure devices typically perform systematic reconnaissance to understand the device configuration, network topology, security policies, connected systems, and potential attack paths. This reconnaissance phase involves executing multiple "show" commands to enumerate
